description: This Java class 'DefaultMapperLimitsConfig' implements a configuration interface for mapper limits, providing properties and methods to access limits such as maximum mappers and message counts for a mapping service within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: DefaultMapperLimitsConfig
classes.description: Implements the MapperLimitsConfig interface to provide configurable limits for the mapper service, with properties for maximum mappers and message counts.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance based on a provided Config object.

methods.name: getMaxSourceMappers
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of source mappers allowed.

methods.name: getMaxMappedInboundMessages
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of inbound messages that can be mapped.

methods.name: getMaxTargetMappers
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of target mappers allowed.

methods.name: getMaxMappedOutboundMessages
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of outbound messages that can be mapped.
